constraints: Run after fresh configure and successful Ninja. Default checks archived proof and exact current source/compiler-edge/raw/processed/target artifacts. --archive-only checks only the historical certificate, not current build state.

Requires exact trusted manifest SHA256 and every indexed file. Does not compile or mutate objects. Archived edge provenance is hash anchored; each baseline is complete ELF identical, not merely normalized assembly.

Native target function must be100 bytes and all6 relocation positions/types/names/addends exact. Only EMB_SDA21 offset2 convention is normalized; no anonymous pool matching used for the native function.

Archive config delta must remove exactly the one memCardErrorPrompt rule. Current owned-unit rules and top-level config must equal archived after state. Foreign current unit config changes are listed explicitly and are NOT certified by this audit.
All29 raw siblings, allocated nontext/BSS/EH and entire prior processed ELF must be preserved. NonMatching target fallback remains; PASS is not a TU flip or a source-unreachability proof.
name: r91_memcard_native_audit
purpose: Read-only, hash-bound native retirement certificate for memCardErrorPrompt and preservation of the entire prior processed memcard ELF.
